responsibility: This machine-description fragment contains peephole2 optimizations that combine adjacent scalar, floating-point, SIMD, and extending loads or stores into AArch64 load-pair and store-pair forms. It recognizes compatible consecutive memory accesses, checks legality and tuning restrictions through helpers such as aarch64_operands_ok_for_ldpstp and aarch64_operands_adjust_ok_for_ldpstp, and either rewrites the access sequence as a PARALLEL pair operation or synthesizes an adjusted base register when the natural offset range is insufficient.
